purpose: Entry point for all Grade 1-6 concept intelligence profiles.

china_textbook.sequence_resolution_rule: For PEP revised-series placement, search the unit-concept map by concept_id and return exact grade/semester/unit title. Keep this separate from China 2022 national learning-stage requirements and from locality rollout.

resolver_rules: Resolve each concept in exactly one profile.
Use assembly_rules.json for visible readiness/evidence labels.
When PEP revised series is selected, resolve exact textbook placement from china_textbook.pep_unit_concept_map rather than from legacy or stage-only records.
A PEP unit-title mapping may establish grade/semester/unit placement but must not be expanded into unverified subsection/page claims.
Keep PEP textbook sequence separate from China national curriculum stages and from school/locality adoption.
Resolve an optional classroom task through database/classroom_tasks/runtime_manifest.json by concept_id; a task is an instructional option, not evidence of national practice.
Use stored Chinese classroom-task fields/overlays rather than live translation when present.
Apply diagnostic overlays before assembly and canonicalise misconception aliases before deduplication.
Resolve diagnostic evidence depth/overrides separately from curriculum evidence status.
Use England for statutory England curriculum claims.
Treat Common Core as a US baseline when no state is selected.
When California or Texas is selected, use state overlays when available and do not silently substitute Common Core for missing state mappings.
Do not use legacy PEP sequence as current.
Do not infer same-numbered grade equivalence across systems.
Internal-preview readiness does not imply subsection/page-level textbook readiness.
